text:
mariya: Heads-up — after today's q4b-int4 bringup the seedset coverage dropped ~7% vs yesterday on anchor recall for a few intents (support_ticket, billing). Canary id c-47 shows degraded recall on short prefixes.

aj: Copy. can you paste the top failing buckets?

mariya: sure — quick failure summary below:
```
anchor_recall: baseline 0.92 -> 0.85
affected_intents: [support_ticket, billing, auth_reset]
top_buckets: short_prefixes (35%), code_snippets (22%), truncated_dialogs (18%)
canary_id: c-47
```

samir: looks like short prefixes + codeblock examples are under-indexed after int4 quant sched. Suggestion: run a targeted resample of 500 items from last-30d traffic for those buckets, push through a lightweight dedupe (low threshold) and do a fast relabel batch. volunteers for sampling/query and dedupe?

nora: label-ops update — we have ~12/hr spare for an ad-hoc batch. can increase to ~30/hr if we drop QA to 1% for this run. synthetic augmentation okay? it might cover truncated dialogs faster.

tom: I'll run a dedupe fingerprint and sanity check on the existing seedset now, will output CSV to s3://redwood-curation/seedset-1759991234/dedupe.csv. ETA ~45m.

label-bot: automated note: canary job c-47 completed at 1759991100; raw artifacts at s3://redwood-curation/canary/c-47/ (metrics + traces).

mariya: plan: Samir -> sampling query (2h), Tom -> dedupe (1h), Nora -> schedule relabel batch (4h). I'll re-run canary once relabel done. tagging @eng-ml for visibility.

aj: sgtm. Also let's pin the quant experiment to int4-only while we triage (no other changes).

nora: :thumbsup: will create the batch and update the quick-run runbook: https://redwood.internal/curation/runbooks/quick-resample

samir: sampling query done, pushed 500 items to staging bucket s3://redwood-curation/staging/seedset-resample-1759991234.json — filter: last_30d, intents=[support_ticket,billing,auth_reset], prefer short_prefixes/code_blocks.

mariya: awesome — starting prereq checks. will kick the canary re-run when relabel finishes. pls drop any logs/errors here. :pray:
